components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A teal outline marks the approval or primary diagnostic action.

components.name: Reject Button
components.description: Rejection uses an explicit action label and muted danger border.

components.name: Reviewer Reason
components.description: Required reasoning for a pending approval or rejection.
components.html: <label class="ds-reason">검토자의 판단 근거<textarea rows="3" minlength="3" maxlength="1000" required placeholder="업무 필요성과 결정 이유를 남겨 주세요."></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-reason{display:block;font:12px "Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#a7b6b1)}.ds-reason textarea{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:6px;border:1px solid #4a6860;background:var(--ground,#101313);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 11px;resize:vertical;caret-color:var(--accent,#68d0c1);font:14px "Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5)}.ds-reason textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#a7b6b1)}.ds-reason textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#68d0c1);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Four real page routes with text labels and a thin selected edge.

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;width:216px;padding:20px;background:var(--ground,#101313);border-right:1px solid var(--line,#2b4440);font:14px "Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:46px;padding:11px 10px;color:var(--muted,#a7b6b1);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--raised,#1c2422);color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5);border-bottom-color:var(--accent,#68d0c1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#68d0c1);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Request Record
components.description: The row retains time, requester, requested scope, state, and report action; mobile CSS wraps rows into records.
components.html: 요청 시각요청자조회 대상승인 대기
components.css: .ds-record{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#2b4440);background:var(--surface,#151a19);color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5);font:13px "Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif}.ds-record small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#a7b6b1)}.ds-pending{color:var(--amber,#e6c384);font-size:12px}.ds-record button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid #4a6860;border-radius:6px;background:var(--ground,#101313);color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5);font-family:"Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s;font-size:12px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 11px}.ds-record button:hover{background:var(--raised,#1c2422);border-color:var(--accent,#68d0c1)}.ds-record button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}.ds-record button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#68d0c1);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-record button{transition:none}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-record{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto}.ds-record>span:first-child{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#a7b6b1)}.ds-record button{min-height:40px}}

components.css: .ds-report{color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5);background:var(--surface,#151a19);border:1px solid #56776e;border-radius:12px;max-width:860px;font-family:"Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif}.ds-report header{display:flex;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;padding:23px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2b4440)}.ds-report h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:600}.ds-report h3{margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-report-body{padding:22px 26px}.ds-report p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}.ds-report summary{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#a7b6b1);cursor:pointer}.ds-report button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid #4a6860;border-radius:6px;background:var(--ground,#101313);color:var(--ink,#f2f6f5);font-family:"Segoe UI","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s;}.ds-report button:hover{background:var(--raised,#1c2422);border-color:var(--accent,#68d0c1)}.ds-report button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}.ds-report button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#68d0c1);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-report button{transition:none}}.ds-report summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#68d0c1);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-report header,.ds-report-body{padding:18px}.ds-report h2{font-size:17px}}

narrative.overview:
The ASG dashboard is a Korean operating surface for reviewing structured database-read requests. The confirmed brief uses neutral dark backgrounds, near-white text, thin teal separation, a left sidebar, and separate overview, approval, audit, and test pages. Charts and measured component states supply the overview; the former request-path diagram is no longer part of the composition.

The Data terminal direction in `.taste-skill/direction.json` (seed `994061310`) remains a reference for restrained density and scanability. The user-approved evolution takes precedence over its generic palette, icon rail, font recommendations, and one-pixel-only accent budget. Offline Korean typography, reason-based review, and explicit status language shape the implemented system.
keyCharacteristics: A persistent labelled sidebar that becomes a mobile drawer.
Flat bordered surfaces, teal separators, and near-white reading text.
Real request outcomes, a scaled 30-minute trend, and measured component states.
A focused request report with required reviewer reasoning.

rules.name: The Thin Separation Rule
rules.body: Structural borders and selected navigation edges are one pixel. Data marks retain their implemented geometry: six-pixel outcome bars, a two-pixel risk line, and eight-pixel status dots. Keyboard focus uses a two-pixel teal outline with a four-pixel offset.

rules.name: The Measured State Rule
rules.body: Show green or red component dots only with an actual status response and explicit words such as normal or connection failure. Unknown state remains neutral.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Separate evidence with spacing, type hierarchy, and thin rules. Reserve the dialog backdrop for focused request review, not general decoration.

dos: Do preserve the neutral dark palette, near-white text, and thin teal separation.
Do use green and red for measured component status with explicit status words.
Do retain the offline Korean font stack and tabular numerals for counts and times.
Do show the metric as-of time and Korean-time scope alongside request counts.
Do preserve report evidence, required reviewer reasons, and the distinction between approval and execution.
Do transform table rows into readable mobile records while keeping the report action visible.
donts: Don't restore the request-path diagram or replace the sidebar with the generic direction's icon rail.
Don't use mono for ordinary Korean labels, request counts, dates, times, or report prose.
Don't add decorative shadows, glows, gradients, or large colored status panels.
Don't imply that the operational risk score is an LLM probability or a breach probability.
Don't present fictional validation records as a connected corporate production database.
